info.name: Retrieves a model response with the given ID.

params.name: response_id
params.description: The ID of the response to retrieve.

params.name: include
params.description:
Specify additional output data to include in the response. Currently
supported values are:
- `file_search_call.results`: Include the search results of
  the file search tool call.
- `message.input_image.image_url`: Include image urls from the input message.
- `computer_call_output.output.image_url`: Include image urls from the computer call output.

params.description: The ID of the response to delete.

info.name: Returns a list of input items for a given response.

params.name: response_id
params.description: The ID of the response to retrieve input items for.

params.name: limit
params.description:
A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between
1 and 100, and the default is 20.

params.name: order
params.description:
The order to return the input items in. Default is `asc`.
- `asc`: Return the input items in ascending order.
- `desc`: Return the input items in descending order.

params.name: after
params.description: An item ID to list items after, used in pagination.

params.name: before
params.description: An item ID to list items before, used in pagination.
